word_order: SVO | e.g. 夏季...会导致睡眠不足 (Subject 夏季... + Verb 会导致 + Object 睡眠不足); 皮特曼认为... (皮特曼 = S, 认为 = V, clause = O)
register: formal informational/expository written prose (encyclopedic, newsy or academic style)
notes_for_prompt_writer: Operate without reliance on word spaces: use punctuation and multi-character discourse markers to detect safe split points. Prefer to wait for clause-final punctuation (。 or clear coordinating/subordinating markers like 而且/但是/虽然) before emitting a segment; do not split immediately after function particles such as 的 or aspect markers like 了. Keep quoted or parenthetical spans and numeric+classifier/year expressions intact (avoid splitting between digits and 年 or inside （...） or “...” ).
